summary: Best 3.991 (vv2 3.655B): the greedy line from the true start now passes the pit - 8/9 episodes reach 3.81-3.99% in ~9-10 s, then die at z ~3,396 just past line_a's end (next gate). How: pbr1b1's line_a curriculum with VELOCITY-ALIGNED spawn views (--demo-view-velocity) - it crossed the wall bounce in ~15 min (round 1: stuck 1.5B+ steps) and ran 1120 -> 490 in 13 min once the bands were contiguous (grow <= window). Why: line_a flies its launch/flight with the view 139-176 deg backward, where the policy's view warp is ~200x coarser; tools/line_track.py re-flies 960->1300 in the policy frame at 25 Hz. Next: policy-frame Go-Explore (explore_phase1 --view-velocity --exact-chains) from the policy's own states before the 3.99% deaths, then extend the curriculum.
